metric_definitions.recall_at_5: Macro average of relevant golden evidence IDs returned in the first 5 divided by all expected IDs (at most 5/case).
metric_definitions.mrr_at_10: Macro mean reciprocal rank of the first expected evidence ID in the first 10 results.
metric_definitions.citation_precision_at_5: Macro average of first-5 result IDs present in the case's expected evidence IDs.
metric_definitions.no_answer_accuracy: Share of insufficient-evidence cases returning zero items.
metric_definitions.filter_violation_rate: Returned items violating any declared structured filter divided by all returned items.
metric_definitions.duplicate_negative_fpr: Distinct synthetic role pairs classified as near duplicate at SimHash similarity >= 0.9.
metric_definitions.warm_latency_p95_ms: Nearest-rank P95 of service-reported latency after one unmeasured warm-up query.

limitations: The retrieval set is deterministically generated from foreign-key-linked MySQL evidence and engineering-reviewed; it is not human domain gold.
Retrieval cases are grouped by standard job into development, validation and test; the split job IDs are recorded in the report.
The current embedding is signed-token-hash-v1 at 256 dimensions through local_deterministic.
Only the development jobs were used for the final retriever tuning pass; the replacement validation and test jobs were frozen before their first evaluation.
